title: Connection-Scoped Tabs & Responsive UI
description: Release v0.8.1 - Improved tab management with connection isolation, refactored API services, and enhanced responsive design for split-screen usage.
highlights: feat: Connection-scoped tabs - each database connection now has its own isolated workspace
feat: RAG Pipeline - AI-powered semantic search across your database tables
feat: Responsive toolbar labels collapse to icons on medium screens (< 768px)
refactor: Generic APIService class for reusable API data synchronization

items.title: Connection-Scoped Tabs
items.description: Each database connection now maintains its own isolated set of tabs. Switching between connections no longer prompts to discard or migrate tabs - each connection remembers its own workspace state.
details: Refactored workspace store to use `workspacesByConnection` map
Added `switchConnection` action for seamless connection switching
Removed the 'Unsaved Tabs' dialog - no longer needed

items.title: Tab Dirty State Indicator
items.description: Tabs now show a minimal amber dot indicator when they have unsaved changes.
details: Added `isDirty` flag to Tab interface
Engine changes automatically update tab dirty state
Minimal visual indicator to reduce UI clutter

items.title: Generic APIService for Data Sync
items.description: Created a reusable APIService class that can fetch data from any external API and sync it to SurrealDB.
details: Supports configurable URL, table, polling interval, and data mapper
StockService refactored to extend APIService
Added WeatherService using Open-Meteo API as demonstration

items.title: RAG Pipeline for Database Knowledge
items.description: Implemented a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that indexes database tables for AI-powered semantic search.
details: RAGService with markdown and table data chunking
Vector embeddings stored in SurrealDB `knowledge_chunk` table
Hybrid search combining vector similarity and keyword matching
API routes for indexing (`POST /rag/index`) and searching (`POST /rag/search`)
Automatic re-indexing support with source clearing

items.title: Responsive Toolbar for Split-Screen
items.description: Toolbar labels now collapse to icons only when the window is narrower than 768px, making the app usable in split-screen mode.
details: ToolbarSpreadsheet: AI Mode, Visualize, Sanitize, Private/Live, Merge labels collapse
ToolbarQuery: Run, Timeout, Limit, Auto-commit labels collapse
ToolbarChat: Model, Temp, Context, Run labels collapse

items.title: Sidebar Responsiveness
items.description: Sidebar adapts better to smaller screens.
details: Reduced minimum sidebar width from 200px to 180px
Sidebar width capped at 250px on screens smaller than 1024px

items.title: Fixed SurrealDB Connection Errors
items.description: Resolved NoActiveSocket and IAM errors during service startup.
details: Services now wait for database connection before starting
Added isConnected guard in sync operations
Fixed INSERT syntax for weather data upserts

items.title: Fixed Stock Symbols with Dots
items.description: Stock symbols containing dots (e.g., BRK.B) are now properly handled by converting dots to underscores in SurrealDB record IDs.
details: Implemented safe ID formatting for stock symbols
Maintains original symbol for display while using sanitized ID for database

items.title: Known Issues
items.description: Issues to be addressed before full release.
details: RAG indexing: Large tables (>10k rows) may timeout - pagination needed
Connection-scoped tabs: Workspace backend persistence not yet implemented for new model

items.title: In Progress
details: RAG: UI for indexing tables and searching - currently API-only
Auto-save: Commit changes before tab switch (infrastructure done, needs testing)
